jobs.occupation: Product Developer / Fullstack Developer till deedooh
jobs.description:
Om deedooh
deedooh är ett svenskt techbolag som utvecklar en plattform för att göra digital utomhusreklam enklare och mer tillgänglig för företag och marknadsförare.
Sedan lanseringen i juni 2026 har vi genomfört kampanjer på 10 internationella marknader. Nu växer vi och söker en ny kollega som vill vara med och utveckla vår plattform vidare.
Om rollen
Vi söker en driven Product Developer / Fullstack Developer som vill vara med och forma framtidens deedooh.
Du arbetar nära grundarna och får en central roll i produktutvecklingen, med stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka både teknik och produkt.
Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:
Utveckla nya funktioner i vår plattform.

Arbeta med frontend, backend och API-integrationer.

Förbättra användarupplevelse och prestanda.

Bidra till tekniska lösningar, produktstrategi och automatisering.

Vem söker vi?
Vi söker en självgående och lösningsorienterad utvecklare med ett starkt intresse för teknik och produktutveckling.
Vi tror att du:
Har erfarenhet av modern webbutveckling, frontend och backend.

Har kunskap om API, databaser och integrationer.

Har känsla för design och användarupplevelse.

Är initiativrik, nyfiken och gillar att lösa problem.

Har intresse för AI och nya tekniska möjligheter.

Kommunicerar obehindrat på engelska.

Erfarenhet av AdTech, SaaS eller kartbaserade applikationer är meriterande. Vi värdesätter kompetens och engagemang högre än formell utbildning.
Vad erbjuder vi?
Hos deedooh blir du en viktig del av ett växande techbolag med internationella ambitioner.
Vi erbjuder en entreprenöriell miljö med korta beslutsvägar, stort inflytande över produktutvecklingen och möjlighet att växa tillsammans med bolaget.
Vill du vara med?
Vi söker dig som vill mer än att bara skriva kod – du vill vara med och bygga något från grunden och göra verklig skillnad.
Låter det intressant? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!
Läs mer på www.deedooh.com.

About deedooh
deedooh is a Swedish tech company developing a platform that makes digital out-of-home advertising simpler and more accessible for businesses and marketers.
Since launching in June 2026, we have delivered campaigns across 10 international markets. We are now growing and looking for a new team member to help take our platform to the next level.
About the Role
We are looking for a driven Product Developer / Fullstack Developer who wants to help shape the future of deedooh.
You will work closely with the founders and play a key role in product development, with significant responsibility and the opportunity to influence both technology and product direction.
Your main responsibilities:
Develop new features and functionality for our platform.

Work across frontend, backend, and API integrations.

Improve user experience and platform performance.

Contribute to technical solutions, product strategy, and automation.

Who Are We Looking For?
We are looking for an independent, solution-oriented developer with a strong passion for technology and product development.
We believe you:
Have experience in modern web development, both frontend and backend.

Have a good understanding of APIs, databases, and integrations.

Have an eye for design and user experience.

Are proactive, curious, and enjoy solving problems.

Have an interest in AI and emerging technologies.

Communicate fluently in English.

Experience in AdTech, SaaS, or map-based applications is a plus. We value skills, ambition, and dedication more than formal education.
What Do We Offer?
At deedooh, you will become an important part of a growing tech company with international ambitions.
We offer an entrepreneurial environment with fast decision-making, significant influence over product development, and the opportunity to grow alongside the company.
Want to Join Us?
We are looking for someone who wants to do more than just write code – someone who is excited about building something from the ground up and making a real impact.
Sound interesting? We'd love to hear from you!
Learn more at www.deedooh.com.

Department of Wildlife, Fish, and Environmental Studies
We are seeking a post doc for a research project focused on understanding biodiversity in managed boreal forests. The project is part of a larger SLU research initiative (the Key Performance Indicator Project) where several researchers, postdocs and PhDs are currently involved, which opens opportunities for collaboration. 
This post doc will focus on issues that concern biodiversity conservation in managed forests by analysing species and structure data from a large-scale field survey conducted in both Sweden and Finland. The research will focus on lichens and polypore fungi, using HMSC modeling to learn how their biodiversity varies based on local forest management and landscape variables. The post doc will work at the Department of Wildlife, Fish and Environmental Studies in Umeå and become a part of a strong research environment focusing on restoration ecology, through empirical studies and large-scale field experiments (see https://www.slu.se/en/departments/wildlife-fish-environmental-studies/research/research-areas/restoration-ecology/). The postdoc will collaborate with the Department of Ecology, the department of Forest Ecology and Management, and the Natural Resources Institute (LUKE) in Finland. 
About the position
The post doc will analyse data from the field survey with the aim of gaining a better understanding of factors controlling species diversity in relation to forest management. They are also expected to write scientific publications together with the research group.
Your profile
The applicant should hold a PhD in ecology (or in a similar relevant subject). As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates obtained a doctoral degree within the last three years. Experience from relevant research questions (Bayesian modeling, Species distribution modeling, terrestrial ecology, nature conservation in forests, landscape ecology, conservation strategies) is a merit. Experience from statistical analyses of large data sets is considered a merit along with a strong publication record (in relation to the time since the doctoral degree). The applicant is expected to be able to take own initiative and work independently and in a group. Excellent skills in written and oral communication in English are required.   
About us
At the Department of Wildlife, Fish and Environmental Studies we offer a creative and stimulating environment and perform internationally recognised basic and applied research, education and environmental monitoring in the areas of biodiversity restoration and conservation, fish biology, wildlife ecology and zoonosis. The department has a large proportion of international employees and well established national and international cooperation which gives opportunities for fruitful exchange. 
For more information about the department or division visit: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/department-of-wildlife-fish-and-environmental-studies/
Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Umeå 
Form of employment:
Temporary employment 24 months, with the possibility of extension.
Scope:
100%
Start date:
According to agreement.  
Application:
Please submit your application before deadline December 10 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.
Union representatives:
https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/
 
 
The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life".
About us
We support managers and executives in their environmental and working environment responsibilities. We comply with requirements according to laws and certifications as well as directives within the company group and communicate continuously internally.   

Job Description

Your contribution to something big
Our department drives the company's sustainability work, and your internship work will contribute to the implementation of local activities and initiatives in this area.
We also need to strengthen our team with an intern who is interested in environmental technology, has a basic understanding of ISO 14001 or similar standards.
The internship includes, among other things, environmental technology, waste management, chemical substances, reporting and project management.
We want you to have experience in problem solving, collecting and analyzing data, contributing to the development of training materials and work instructions.

Duration of the internship: 6 months, preferably starting February 2027
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden

Qualifications

What distinguishes you
You are an organizer, happy to take on projects and organize events in the area of sustainability.
Our company language is English, but we work on production projects and it would be beneficial if you could also communicate in Swedish, so a basic knowledge of Swedish is an advantage.
Ongoing studies in Industrial Engineering and Management, Sustainability Management, Safety & Environmental Engineering, or a related field.
Knowledge and experience of Microsoft Office 365 with a special emphasis on Word Excel and PowerPoint.
Good communication skills, both verbal and written.
Problem solving skills.
Please note: Only applications from students that are currently studying are accepted.

Monetary compensation is included to support you during your internship

To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer at Bosch Thermotechnology AB
jobs.description:
Company Description

Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources – rock, water, and air.
In Tranås, you’ll find both our production unit and our competence and development center, where we constantly strive to stay at the forefront. Here we create smart solutions that simplify everyday life, contribute to a greener future, and provide our customers with safety and comfort
We believe in technology that makes a difference – technology that is Invented for life.

Job Description

Join the Electric Solutions group at Bosch Home Comfort, where software engineering and DevOps come together to support the development of heat pump applications. You will work closely with engineers using model-based development approaches, building a strong understanding of how their software is designed, implemented, tested, integrated, and maintained. 
You will use that understanding to shape reliable, practical tools and workflows that make continuous software development easier. From fast feedback during development to reproducible builds and releases, your work will help teams deliver high-quality software with confidence. 
Your contribution to something big:
Enable continuous development: Design and improve CI/CD workflows that support the way software teams work, from early development and integration through testing and delivery.
Enhance automation: Automate builds, tests, code analysis, packaging, and release activities, with useful feedback that helps engineers identify issues early.
Put software quality first: Consider what matters throughout the development lifecycle, including testability, reproducible builds, version control, traceability, and maintainability.
Partner with engineers: Collaborate with software teams and turn real needs into effective platform improvements.
Improve developer experience: Reduce repetitive manual work and help teams integrate and validate changes frequently and reliably.
Keep delivery systems dependable: Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot build and integration issues, and address bottlenecks across teams and sites.
Scale delivery infrastructure: Contribute to reliable and scalable build infrastructure, including cloud-based services.

Qualifications

What distinguishes you:
Education: 
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields. 

Professional Experience & Skills: 
Methodologies: Solid experience in software development, CI/CD, DevOps and agile practices at scale.
Programming: Practical programming skills in Bash, Git, Python, Go, and C. 
Operating Systems: Practical knowledge with Linux and Windows systems.
DevOps Tooling: Practical knowledge of Jenkins, SonarQube, jFrog Artifactory, Bitbucket, Jira, and GitHub.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools (Ansible, Terraform) and server administration (Windows/Linux) is a plus.
Additional Tech Stack: Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, NoSQL databases (such as MongoDB), Grafana, Conan, and Maven is beneficial.

Interpersonal & Language Skills: 
Languages: Fluent in English
Working Style: Highly organized, collaborative, proactive, and structured with strong planning capabilities. 
Personality: Responsible, self-driven, eager to innovate and continuously learn, with a strong willingness to collaborate within international teams (including willingness for occasional business travel). 

Additional Information

Are you an experienced HR professional who enjoys working closely with managers and employees? Do you thrive in a hands-on role where you can combine you HR expertise with a proactive and service-minded approach?
We are now looking for a Senior People Partner to join Visual Components and KUKA Group in Finland. Here, you will take on a broad and varied HR role with the opportunity to contribute to developing processes and ways of working within an international organisation.
Sounds interesting? We look forward to receiving your application! 

ABOUT THE ROLE As Senior People Partner, you will support managers and employees across Visual Components and other KUKA businesses in Finland. You will act as a trusted point of contact for everyday HR matters, providing guidance and ensuring effective HR processes throughout the employee lifecycle.
The role is part of the Nordic People & Organisation (P&O) function and you will work closely with local managers, Nordic P&O colleagues and the Shared Service Centre in Hungary, contributing to consistent HR processes and ways of working.
Your main responsibilities will include:
• Provide day-to-day HR support and guidance to managers and employees. • Manage employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, internal movements, leave and offboarding. • Advise on HR policies, procedures and employee relations matters. • Coordinate local HR processes and ensure accurate employee records. • Support performance reviews, development initiatives and organisational changes.
The position is based at Visual Components’ office in Espoo, Finland, and you report to the Head of P&O Nordic in Sweden. 

ABOUT YOU We are looking for an experienced HR professional with a broad operational background who enjoys working hands-on and building strong relationships across the organisation. You are confident in your HR expertise, comfortable working independently and thrive in a changing international environment.
We believe you have:
• At least 10 years of experience in operational HR. • Broad knowledge of HR processes, employee relations and local employment practices. • Experience advising managers on a variety of HR matters. • A relevant university degree, preferably within HR. • Fluency in Finnish and English.
Experience from an international matrix organisation, a technology or engineering environment, or SAP SuccessFactors is considered an advantage. Swedish language skills are also a plus.
As a person, you are proactive, structured and approachable. You communicate clearly, take initiative and enjoy finding practical solutions. You are comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues in a changing environment. 

CONTACT Does this opportunity sound interesting and align with your experience and ambitions? In this recruitment process, Visual Components and KUKA Group is partnering with Committo. For more information, please contact Linda Samuelsson at linda.samuelsson@committo.se or +46 702 16 37 52 or Sofia Erikson at sofia.erikson@committo.se or +46 73-642 75 69.
Interviews and selection are conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you! 

ABOUT THE COMPANY KUKA is a global automation corporation with sales of around 4 billion euro and approximately 15,000 employees. The company is headquartered in Augsburg, Germany. As one of the world’s leading suppliers of intelligent automation solutions, KUKA offers customers everything they need from a single source: from robots and cells to fully automated systems and their networking in markets such as automotive, electronics, metal & plastic, consumer goods, e-commerce/retail and healthcare.
Visual Components is a leading developer of 3D manufacturing simulation software and solutions. Founded in 1999 by a team of simulation experts, we started with a humble goal – to make manufacturing design and simulation technology easy to use and accessible to manufacturing organizations of all sizes. Since 2017 Visual Components has been a part of KUKA Group.

We are looking for a Material Data Specialist (MDM) who will be a European Product Data Specialist. This is a consultancy assignment starting from 1st December to the end of September 2027.
About the company
Unilever is one of the world´s leading consumer goods companies, with a portfolio of well-known brands across food, personal care, beauty and home care. With a strong focus on innovation, sustainability and growth, Unilever operates in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where collaboration and continuous improvement are key to success.
About Customer Operations Europe
The Customer Operations team consist of various roles and teams that make Excellent Execution a success. The Customer Operations teams focus on less time spent on ‘Running the Business’ to reinvest in ‘Growing the Business’ whilst improving Customer and Employee Satisfaction. Operations brings Sales, Supply Chain and Marketing within Unilever together in realizing excellent execution. The 4 principles driving Customer Operations are: end 2 end ownership, maximized automation, one version of the truth and continuous improvement. Team members within Customer Operations embrace the vision and their daily work practice reflects the 4 principles of Operations. Operations effectively works in a cross-country setting, embracing cultural diversity and working in virtual teams.
Competencies key to make Customer Operations a success, are:
Practical creativity
Enterprising behavior                            
Ability to learn

Job summary
As a Product Data Specialist in Customer Operations Europe, you will play a pivotal role in developing end-to-end European product data management (EPDM). EPDM ensures the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of product data across our portfolio. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, supply chain, R&D, and IT, to manage and optimize product data information systems. Your responsibilities will include maintaining product data, overseeing data entry processes, and implementing data governance standards to ensure end-to-end product data management. Furthermore you support the MDM improvement processes by monitoring, evaluating, and resolving processing/programming issues, by coming up with tangible solutions for EPDM systems and related material data sources.
Within the EPDM team, there are three areas of expertise among the European Product Data Specialists:
Material data specialist
End-to-end data specialist
Data flow specialist

During your time as a European Product Data Specialist, you will have the opportunity to alternate between the different expertise groups.
The material data specialists focus is on managing the product data that is classified as material data. Material data relates to the internal supply chain product data; weights, dimensions, hierarchies, transport and storage specifications. The material data specialist is responsible for:
Data enrichment- Creating on-time and in-full data
Data governance- Ensuring on-time and in-full data from Unilever central master data management (MDM) hub
KPI performance- Deliver on target performance on the EPDM KPI’s

Key responsibilities
Data Accuracy and Quality: Ensure all material product data is accurate, complete, and up-to-date.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensure product data complies with local and international regulations.
Data Governance: Establish and maintain data governance policies to ensure data integrity and availability.
Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for improving data management processes and implement best practices to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
Process Improvement: Identifying and implementing best practices for data management.
Master Data Management (MDM): Overseeing master data creation and maintenance.
Data Standardization: Ensuring adherence to data standards.
Data Cleansing: Regularly auditing and cleaning data.
Innovation Tracking: Monitoring innovations in data management.

Required skills & qualifications
Proficiency in the English language.
Attention to Detail: Ensuring data accuracy and quality.
Data Integration Skills: Integrating and synchronizing data across systems.
Product Information Management (PIM): Managing centralized product information systems.
Data Governance: Establishing and maintaining data governance policies.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Working with various departments to meet data needs.
Analytical Ability: Analysing process optimization patterns.
Stakeholder Management: Persuading teams to adopt process standards.
Change Management: Leading process change initiatives.
Continuous Improvement: Constantly enhancing processes.
Communication: Effectively conveying process requirements.

How do you grow an extraordinary business while preserving what makes it unique? As Commercial Director at Koenigsegg, you will be part of shaping the answer.

Working closely with the COO, you will align strategic direction with commercial performance, consolidate insights from across the business and translate commercial, financial and operational data into actionable recommendations that inform strategic and operational decisions. Through this work, you will drive profitable growth and build lasting customer relationships while protecting the brand’s exclusivity and integrity.

This newly created role offers the opportunity to shape how our commercial functions work together. Leading managers across sales, marketing, events, merchandise, commercial support and aftermarket special projects, you will unite these functions around shared priorities and connect market opportunities with the business’s ability to deliver.

You will report directly to the COO and be based on-site in Ängelholm, Sweden.

What you will do

Develop annual and quarterly commercial plans, budgets and targets, setting priorities, monitoring progress and driving corrective action.

Own international sales performance, order intake, pipeline quality, forecasting and market development.

Strengthen dealer performance and build trusted relationships with key customers, collectors and partners.

Lead, coach and develop managers, establishing clear responsibilities and accountability while enabling them to own daily operations.

Oversee business cases, pricing, contract terms and profitability for special projects, ensuring customer commitments are feasible, aligned with financial and operational priorities, and approved before they are made.

Set commercial objectives for launches, campaigns, partnerships, events and merchandise, working closely with responsible managers and the Creative Director, who is responsible for creative direction and final approval of creative execution.

Turn commercial and financial data into actionable strategies, forecasts, dashboards and concise executive presentations.

Lead monthly performance reviews with the COO, highlighting results, risks and recommended actions.

Skills & Requirements

10+ years of progressive commercial leadership experience.

Extensive experience in luxury, premium automotive, technology-led products or another high-value, low-volume business, where growth depends on balancing commercial ambition with exclusivity and long-term customer relationships.

Demonstrated success leading managers across commercial functions, developing capability and delivering measurable results through others.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including previous P&L responsibility with sound judgement in pricing, negotiation, budgeting, margins, cash flow and investment decisions.

Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to absorb, assess and synthesise large volumes of complex data, identify what matters and present clear conclusions to different audiences.

Strong understanding of commercial systems and processes, with experience using CRM systems to connect data, reporting and decision-making. Salesforce experience is highly desirable.

Full professional fluency in English. Swedish and other international languages are advantageous.

A relevant degree in business, marketing or a related field is preferred.

How you lead

You will lead a team of approximately 10 people.

Your leadership combines strategic judgement with disciplined execution and a structured, discreet and collaborative approach. You build trust with senior leaders, creative teams and technical experts, and remain decisive and composed in demanding situations.

Through clear expectations, coaching and delegation, you develop managers and enable them to turn shared goals into measurable results.

Do you want to help shape what’s next for Koenigsegg?

We look forward to receiving your application.

Koenigsegg is most known for building some of the fastest cars in the world; with almost all of our megacar technologies that are patented and made in-house by our almost 750 world-class technicians, engineers, sourcing experts, production craftsmen, and communicators.

What we’ve created is a unique proving ground of engineering creativity that makes use of our breakthrough megacar development and legacy to push the boundaries of sustainable mobility technology.

So, what’s next?

We are on a universe-denting mission to develop the next generation of breakthrough tech and products. We are looking for outstanding, impactful, and authentic individuals to grow with us. Our ambitions are inspiring but will push the limits of what is possible – requiring one to work efficiently amid our cross-functional teams to execute at high-quality levels.

The goal is clear: innovate and transform.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer – Innovative Wind Propulsion Technology
jobs.description:
Mechanical Engineer – Oceanbird

Are you a Mechanical Engineer who enjoys turning technical designs into practical solutions? Would you like to contribute to innovative technology that is helping transform the global shipping industry?
Briljantin Consulting is currently looking for a Mechanical Engineer for our client Oceanbird.
Oceanbird is developing innovative wind propulsion technology with the ambition to reduce emissions from commercial shipping. The company is a joint venture between Alfa Laval and Wallenius, combining extensive industrial experience with pioneering engineering solutions.
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will join Oceanbird's Customer Projects team, where you will play an important role in adapting and delivering mechanical solutions for customer-specific installations.
You will be involved throughout the entire project lifecycle, from requirements and mechanical design to manufacturing, installation and commissioning. The role offers a combination of technical engineering, practical problem-solving and collaboration with international customers, suppliers and shipyards.
Your main responsibilities
Develop and adapt mechanical designs for customer-specific projects and installations.

Translate customer and vessel requirements into practical engineering solutions.

Produce and review 3D models, manufacturing drawings, technical specifications, calculations and documentation.

Manage mechanical interfaces between Oceanbird's technology, vessels and shipyard structures.

Participate in design reviews, risk assessments and technical investigations.

Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing partners regarding quality, cost and delivery.

Provide technical support during installation, commissioning and testing.

Contribute to continuous improvements, standardization and engineering best practices.

Ensure compliance with relevant marine regulations, classification requirements and internal processes.

Key and mandatory skills
We believe you have:

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or a related technical field.

Experience in mechanical design, product development or project engineering.

Good knowledge of 3D CAD software and experience producing manufacturing drawings.

Understanding of materials, manufacturing methods, tolerances and mechanical interfaces.

Strong analytical, documentation and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently and take responsibility for technical deliverables.

Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Desired skills
It is considered an advantage if you have experience or knowledge in one or more of the following areas:

Maritime, offshore, heavy machinery or renewable energy industries.

Ship structures, vessel integration or marine installations.

Hydraulic systems, rotating machinery or large mechanical structures.

Marine classification rules and regulatory requirements.

Installation, commissioning and testing of mechanical equipment.

Working with international suppliers, shipyards or customers.

About you
We are looking for a collaborative, structured and solution-oriented engineer with a genuine interest in mechanical engineering and technical development.
You enjoy taking ownership of your work and finding practical solutions to complex engineering challenges. You are comfortable working across different technical disciplines and understand the importance of balancing technical performance with quality, project timelines and cost requirements.
You have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating with colleagues, customers and external partners.
Above all, you are motivated by seeing your engineering work become part of real-world installations.
Location and travel
The position is based at Oceanbird's office in Flemingsberg, Stockholm.
As the role supports international customer projects, you should be willing and able to travel to shipyards, customer sites and installation locations. Travel frequency and duration will vary depending on project requirements.
Why join Oceanbird?
At Oceanbird, you will have the opportunity to work with pioneering wind propulsion technology that contributes to the decarbonization of the shipping industry.
You will become part of a highly competent and dedicated team, working in an innovative and international environment where engineering expertise, collaboration and practical execution are key.
This is an opportunity to follow technical solutions from initial engineering through installation and operation, while contributing to a more sustainable future for global shipping.
Does this sound like you?
Then we look forward to receiving your application!
For more information about the position, please contact Briljantin Consulting.
We review applications continuously, so please submit your application as soon as possible.
We don't accept applications sent directly via email.

jobs.occupation: Research and Development Engineer in Techno-Economic Assessment
jobs.employer_name: RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB
jobs.description:
Are you driven, analytical and eager to make a change and drive development? Join RISE Processum and work on research projects to develop the bio-based processes of the future together with the industry.
RISE is a gathering of forces for the sustainable transition that business, society, and the world need. We work with the solutions that can make a difference here and now, and with the areas of knowledge and techniques that can be crucial tomorrow.
About us At RISE Processum, we are developing the bio-based processes of the future together with the industry. Through chemistry and biotechnology, we seek to maximize resource efficiency and sustainability in the utilization of society's residual streams for new fossil-free products in food, feed, chemicals, materials and fuel. Within our cluster activities, guidance in techno-economic assessment to both large and small companies in the bioeconomy is a crucial step in the development of new sustainable and competitive concepts.
Our projects range from shorter assignments to larger national and international research projects, often in collaboration with colleagues from RISE's various areas of expertise. You will be part of the Innovationssystem group within Processum, consisting of 10 colleagues.
About the role In collaboration with a team of experts in biotechnology, chemistry, process simulations, business development and technoeconomic assessments, you will develop new research and development projects from idea to finished results. You will conduct contract research to support industry in developing roadmaps for expanding or transitioning existing businesses into competitive and sustainable new market offerings. A substantial part of the role involves developing tools and knowledge through publicly funded collaborative projects, as well as contributing to the development of internal TEA activities at RISE.
You will identify customer needs and build strong customer relationships and develop new business opportunities. This includes securing project funding, preparing funding applications, and contributing to sales and contract-based projects.
The location is Örnsköldsvik. We follow a hybrid work model that allows employees to split their working time between the office and their home workspace. The role includes travel in connection with international projects, such as attending project meetings, events, and conferences.
Who are you? To be successful in the role you are analytical, structured and self-driven. You are motivated by developing projects to create value together with colleagues and partners. You are good at building relationships and with your interest in technology from a societal perspective, you identify needs and turn them into action. You have a strong interest in project management and communication of results.
Requirements for the role
• A Master’s degree in Engineering or Natural Sciences, preferably in Biotechnology or Chemistry
• Experience from working in or closely linked to bioeconomy related industries
• Experience in performing value chain analyses at different levels and techno-economic assessment, preferably on biobased processes
• Experience with process simulations tools
• Project management experience within research and development
• You speak and write fluently in Swedish or English
Are we a good match? At Processum, you will work close to one of Europe’s leading technology infrastructures for the bioeconomy and contribute to strengthening RISE’s capabilities in scale-up, testing and demonstration. You will work with a wide variety of concepts and value chains in an international and dynamic environment, with colleagues representing many different nationalities. At RISE, we like different things and we are convinced that diversity contributes to an innovative environment where we together challenge boundaries and develop new knowledge and skills for the future.
Welcome with your application! If this sounds exciting and you want to know more, please contact Johan Börjesson, Director of Innovation Systems, johan.borjesson@ri.se, +46 738 032 315. The application deadline is December 2. Selection and interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Apply with CV and questionnaire (no cover letter needed).
Our union representatives are Frida Sandberg (+46 10 516 67 79) and Veronica Benavente (+46 76 935 86 32) for Unionen and Johanna Källman, +46 10 516 60 10 for Saco.

Job Description

IKEA Range & Supply has the responsibility to develop, design, produce and supply IKEA stores with home furnishing solutions available to the many people. Each year IKEA Range & Supply introduce 2,000 new products in the IKEA stores. The total range is almost 10,000 products.
Älmhult is home to IKEA of Sweden. Here the IKEA range is developed and made available to stores and customers all over the world. At IKEA of Sweden, you will work in a truly international and dynamic environment. You will have different opportunities to learn new skills and where the goal always is to create a better everyday life for the many people.
Hej, my name is Monika. Right now, I´m looking for an Accounts Payable Specialist to the Accounting department in Älmhult.
We offer a challenging and inspiring role where you will have the possibility to be a part of a great team working together to support the business in the best possible way. You will together with the team and our stakeholders continuously work to improve our processes, to gain efficiency and to achieve excellence in our operations. 
Are you ready to grow with us? Keep on reading!
The accounting department at IKEA of Sweden support several Inter IKEA companies both within and outside Sweden with Accounting services. You will be a part of the team that provide support related to the Accounts Payable (AP) process and responsible for that all invoices processed in a proper and timely way, according to global or local guidelines and routines. As Accounts Payable Specialist you work close to the other team members, and your main tasks and responsibilities are to give timely and clear support related to the Accounts Payable (AP) process. Ensure that all invoices are coded with correct accounting string (all elements), VAT code and processed according to PoA (Power of Attorney) for the Inter IKEA Company; maintain the supplier master data and users of the AP invoice handling system; participate in monthly closings of the AP system and the accruals of invoices; provide support connected to the accounts payable processes to co-workers within Inter IKEA companies and to external suppliers.
You will also be responsible for loading supplier payment proposals in a timely and accurate way; actively participate in the work to increase efficiency and quality; participate in creating/maintaining manuals, guides, and routines to help others in the team and to improve the processes.
To be successful in this role you need to be curious and open to new ways of working and strive to improve processes. Accurate, analytical, and have attention to details. Service minded and communicated in a clear and simple way.  We want you to be structured and could prioritize completing your tasks efficiently. 
We believe that you have working experience within Swedish Accounting- and VAT legislation connected with the Account Payables processes. You need to have good knowledge in Swedish and English, both writing and speech. Knowledge in Microsoft office, Excel, and experience from working with financial systems is also needed for the role.
You can have a bachelor’s degree in business administration or YH-education in Accounting, but equivalent working experience is also fine.
The IKEA values motivates you and creating a better everyday life for the many people who guide you in your work.
